title: Nutrition bu mag bi xamul
intro: Ci barab bu sell bi ci këru Yàlla, benn jaamu Yàlla bu mag dafa dundu kumpa gu xóot gu ëpp luñu ko mëna seentu. Nit ku gëm Yàlla, weesu at yu bari ci nekk waajur, seede na lu yéeme luy wane yërmaande bu amul àpp bu Yàlla. Puzzle bi mingi ci wane jamono jiñ fatte ci dundu yonent yi.
clues: Sama askan ñu ngi ko xamee ci Israel, di doomi maam bu mag bu yàgg.
Samay guddi yépp dama daan ñaan, sukku ci kanamu sama Boroom ci barabu jaamukaay bi.
Ci sama màgget, ñu may ma doom ju góor, muy kado buma musul xàddi ci màggal Yàlla.
Sama àtte dafa doon gis luy dundal benn ruuh bu ndaw buma yor.
Man Yonent laa woon bu tuddu Zakariyya, ñu dénk ma toppatoo Maryam ci Baytul Maqdis.
Tontu li mingi ci aaya bi Yàlla nangu Maryam, di ko dundal.

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
